messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — seeing a kv-cache edge-case that corrupts long-prefix streams. propose a minimal hotpatch (v2.7.3-railgun). plan to cut in ~70m. tiny diff but want CR + a short canary smoke.

Priya: which branch are we patching? keep it one commit only? :eyes:

Alex: branching off stable/2.7 -> hotfix/railgun-2.7.3. cherry-pick is a single 8-line change in cache_manager.cc. no config or schema changes.

Marco: pinging @Priya for review. I can run a quick perf sanity after CI. can we skip full modelbench and just do tokens/sec check?

Priya: grabbing the PR now. will only merge after CI green + one ACK from Jamie. if tests pass and smoke looks good, I'll land.

Jamie: ACK in principle. please add a changelog entry: "Fix: KV cache invalidation on long streams (2.7.3)" and note "No DB migrations required" under upgrade guidance.

Sasha: ops note — we'll use rolling restarts for Dedicated racks. estimate 3-6min reduced throughput per rack. I'll notify SRE and set the maintenance marker.

Alex: release-bot, schedule cutoff: stop merges into stable/2.7 in 60m, hold any further rollouts until patch cut.

release-bot: cutoff timer set — cutoff at 2367954921 (60m from now). please ensure PRs are in final review. :timer_clock:

ci-bot: CI started for PR #4872 on hotfix/railgun-2.7.3 — running unit, integration, smoke. ETA ~10m.

Marco: quick smoke plan: (1) deploy to canary pool (1 GPU), (2) run 1k token stream with deep prefix, (3) confirm kv cache stability. test command below:

```
# from infra-tools
./tools/stream_test --model redwood-tiny --tokens 1000 --prefix 1200
```

Priya: will run the script on canary once CI passes. abort rollout on any failures.

ci-bot: unit+integration passed. smoke pending.

ci-bot: canary smoke completed — 1/1 canary OK. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/4872/logs

Marco: quick perf check after canary: tokens/s within baseline noise, latency p50 unchanged.

Jamie: changelog entry added and PR description updated with deploy instructions. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4872

Priya: merging now (after Jamie ACK).

ci-bot: merge detected. creating tag v2.7.3-railgun and kicking off release pipeline.

release-bot: tag created v2.7.3-railgun at sha abcdef1. starting canary deployment to pool canary-railgun.

Sasha: incident note posted in #incidents; on-call alerted. I'll monitor rack health during rollout.

Marco: canary looks stable after 12m observation. proceeding with phased rollout across racks.

Alex: excellent. keep updates in this thread if anything odd. after full roll, let's do a brief retro and file a test to catch this case earlier.

Priya: rollout complete, all racks healthy. closing cutoff. :tada:

release-bot: Release v2.7.3-railgun completed. changelog auto-updated.

Jamie: filed follow-up ticket to add a unit test for the cache edge-case and a small postmortem doc.

Alex: thanks everyone, nice and tidy. closing thread.
